title: Testis
description: Seminiferous tubules cut in many planes, with spermatogenesis, and the interstitial tissue between them, which holds blood vessels and groups of Leydig cells.
look_for: Seminiferous tubules cut across and lengthways
Spermatogonia at the edge of each tubule; spermatocytes, spermatids and spermatozoa towards the lumen
Sertoli cells, with pale nuclei near the base of the tubule
Leydig (interstitial) cells in groups between the tubules: pink cytoplasm and round nuclei

labels.find: the lumen of a seminiferous tubule

labels.text: Spermatogenic cells (spermatogonia at the edge, spermatocytes inside them)

labels.find: a blood vessel between the tubules

source.name: GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression) project
source.pathology_note: 2 pieces  ~7x6mm, spermatogenesis is present; remarkably well preserved
source.via: NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC), collection gtex
source.changes: A region of the slide was cut out and re-encoded as a WebP image pyramid; nothing else was changed.
